raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops late-arriving POSTED transactions. From batch 3 on, batches carry transactions that are 2–3 days old (e.g. batch 11 txn_ts 01-13 06:01 vs ingest 01-16 02:00). txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates, and the rows are valid. Removing the lateness filter and keeping the POSTED filter restores them.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.75,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
